semantics.kind: pure combinational next-state equations, no stored state
semantics.Y3: next-state bit 3 (D): w & (y[1] | y[2] | y[4] | y[5])
semantics.timing: Outputs follow current inputs combinationally; no clock, cycle latency, or handshake
semantics.reset_initialization: FSM reset state A is contextual; this module has no reset port or internal state and requires no initialization
semantics.legal_inputs: one-hot y encoding A through F and binary w
semantics.illegal_inputs: No required recovery for zero-hot, multi-hot, or unknown states; direct equations extend naturally without validity gating

numeric.representation: unsigned six-bit state vector and one-bit Boolean signals
numeric.operations: single-bit bitwise NOT, AND and OR only
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, truncation, saturation, or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent transition table indexed by state A-F and input w; compare destination state B and D with Y1 and Y3
verification.coverage: All 12 legal state/input combinations, repeated in reverse order to detect accidental state retention
verification.checks: Contract gate before RTL, static interface and source review, Icarus -g2012 compilation with explicit dev_tb top, self-checking simulation
verification.timeouts: Finite external timeouts for each compile and simulation plus internal testbench watchdog
verification.scope: Independent development verification only; no official evaluation, synthesis, or board checks

specification_ambiguities.issue: Prose names Y2/Y4 but explicit ports are Y1/Y3
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use exact declared interface Y1/Y3 for next-state bits y[1]/y[3] respectively

specification_ambiguities.issue: Reset into A mentioned without reset/clock ports
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Treat as context for the external FSM; implement only requested combinational equations
